title: The Chosen Commander
start: Talk to Captain Undak, north-east of the market in Dorgesh-Kaan, just across from the bank.

items.t: Full H.A.M. robe outfit (obtained during quest - you are given a new set)
5,000 coins (if player wrongly accuses an innocent merchant)

recommended.t: Food, armour, and weapon (two different combat styles for fight with H.A.M. agents)
Underneath Lumbridge Castle, unblock the wall to Lumbridge Swamp Caves south of Kazgar. It must be done from Kazgar's side. This saves a great deal of time later.

kills.t: The statues are all weak to Magic attacks both during and after the quest.

rewards.t: The ability to buy Bandos throne room spheres from Oldak to return to the Bandos's throne room
The ability to fight goblin statues, ork statues, ogre statues, and ourg statues inside Bandos's throne room by climbing on them
Access to the Bandos Agility Course inside Bandos's throne room
You can claim the goblin cower shield by talking to General Wartface or General Bentnoze in the Goblin Village

steps.t: Talk to Captain Undak, east of the bank (by the eastern water fountain) in Dorgesh-Kaan. (You must dismiss any follower or pet you have or he will not go with you.) [Chat: 2 Can I help with anything? › 1 Yes. › 2 Okay. What's your point? › Accept]

Climb the nearby stairs (slightly north of Undak) and talk to Torzek outside the nursery. [Chat: 4 Calm down. I'm here to help. › 1 Have the children eaten anything unusual lately? › 1 What did they have?]
p: Torzek taking care of the sick children.

steps.t: Talk to any nearby child against the building wall about what they ate.

sub.t: Andil: [Chat: ? What food did you eat yesterday?] The chat options may vary from person to person.
Delgon: [Chat: 1 What food did you have yesterday?]
Gerdi: [Chat: 1 What food did you eat yesterday?]

steps.t: Talk to Captain Undak. [Chat: 3 I've worked out which foods are poisoned.] (If you are unable to talk with Captain Undak, make sure you do not have "Hide Familiar options" checked under Settings>Combat & Action Bar>Choose Option Menu and log out and back in)
p: Zanik joins battle when Walton activates prayer.

steps.t: Go down the stairs and head south to the market.
Talk to Markog, at the south-eastern-most stall of the market. [Chat: 1 Which merchants have you bought ingredients from?]
Talk to Turgok, at the south-western-most stall of the market. [Chat: 1 Which merchants have you bought ingredients from?]
Talk to Merchant Walton, just outside of the market to the south-east. [Chat: 1 This is the one, Captain. › 1 Yes, I'm sure. › 3 [Attack the merchant] › 1 What's that behind you?]
Proceed to kill the merchant (Zanik will switch to melee if you use ranged).
Talk to Zanik. [Chat: Any › Any › 1 Yes! What happened?]
Climb on the goblin south-west of the bowl statue.
Jump on statues to reach the statue holding the bowl of water.

sub.t: If the jump-on option does not appear, try clicking on the head.

p: Statues moving out of the way for Zanik

steps.t: Continue jumping north and take the crossbow from the ledge.
Grapple the spear of the north-eastern statue and take the pendant.
Look into the bowl.
Enter the western portal (the statues will move out of the way) for a cutscene.
Continue conversation with Zanik. [Chat: 1 Let's go.]
With Zanik following, go to the north end of Dorgesh-Kaan and up the northern most set of stairs.
Watch the cutscene. [Chat: Any › 3 Zanik is right. You should kill him. › 1 She means well. › Any]
Continue conversation with Captain Undak. [Chat: 1 Where should I look? › 4 I'll start looking now.]
Run south of the city, up and over staircases until you reach the agility course. Bring a light source.
Climb-down the ladder top and head all the way south.

Talk to Zanik. [Chat: 4 [Sit down next to Zanik.] › 4 [Say nothing.] › 4 [Say nothing.] › 4 [Say nothing.] › 2 Yes, but you should have respected the council. › Any › 4 What do you wish had happened? › 1 Someday, we'll build that world.]
Watch the cutscene. [Chat: Any › 3 I have nothing else to say.]
After the cutscene talk to Zanik. [Chat: 4 Goodbye, Zanik.]
Talk to Captain Undak for a set of H.A.M. robes. [Chat: 1 What is this task? › 1 I'll do it.]
Prepare for battle, but only wear the H.A.M. robes.
Enter the H.A.M. Hideout in Lumbridge forest.

Talk to Johanhus Ulsbrecht in the centremost of the three southern rooms. [Chat: 3 What are you planning to do about the cave goblins? › 3 Isn't Sigmund working with you any more? › 3 How can I find Sigmund's base? › 1 I'll go there now.]

sub.t: Before you do, make sure to wear all of the H.A.M. robes

steps.t: Talk to Milton in the windmill near the Fishing Guild, north of the Ardougne lodestone. [Chat: 2 I want to get in to Sigmund's base. › 1 Arrav.]
Climb down the ladder inside the windmill.
Run directly east through the door, continuing east through stacks of crates.
Talk to the guard next to the prison. [Chat: 1 I need to see the prisoner. › 1 Letter? › 3 What day is it today? › 3 Never mind.]
Enter the main area (back through the doors to the west) and pickpocket Sam.
Return to the prison guard. [Chat: 1 I have my letter here.]
Enter the prison and take the key, open the gate.
Escape with Grubfoot:

sub.t: Talk to the prisoner, Grubfoot. [Chat: 4 Wait there. I'll come back for you.]
Run into the kitchen, squeeze through the hole.
Open 1 of the 2 doors.
Go back through and open the other door as well.
Return to Grubfoot. [Chat: 1 Let's go › 3 I'll distract the guard so you can make a break for it.]

Stand north of the guard, talk to him to face you and have his back turned. After selecting the chat option, do not continue the conversation until Grubfoot walks past the guard into the next room. [Chat: Any]
Talk to Grubfoot in the next room. [Chat: 2 Wait at the west door; I'll distract the guard.]
Squeeze into the kitchen. Take the dirty plates from the sink, and wait for the H.A.M. guard to come talk to you. [Chat: 1 Yes. › Any]
Talk to Grubfoot in the bedroom. [Chat: 1 Follow me.]
Exit the east door and run to the big doors north. [Chat: 1 Let's get out of here.]

steps.t: Watch the cutscene and wait for Sigmund to confront you. [Chat: 3 Time for you to die!]
Kill Sigmund. [Chat: Any]

sub.t: If Zanik doesn't attack Sigmund, climb up the ladder, then back down.

steps.t: Kill Zanik repeatedly. [Chat: 1 I won't kill you, Zanik. › 3 Zanik! What's happened to you? › 3 Does our friendship mean nothing to you? › 1 But am I *your* enemy? › 2 Zanik, you're being controlled. Fight it! › 3 Zanik, it's the pendant. Take it off! › 2 You've got to do it, otherwise it will win!]

sub.t: Turn off revolution in combat settings and avoid using bleeds and channelled abilities as they cancel the dialogue forcing you to repeat the phase.
If revolution was left on and dialogue interrupted, run up and then down the ladder to the west to avoid having to fight again.

steps.t: Run west for an earthquake.
Right click Clear the fallen rocks.

Talk to Zanik. [Chat: 4 Try grappling across with your crossbow. › 1 I can see somewhere it could catch. › 2 Right a bit. › 2 Right a bit. › 1 You've overshot. Go left. › 1 It's alright, Zanik. You can do it. › 1 Just a bit further left. › 1 I'm not leaving you, Zanik.]
Go through the cave and talk to Juna.
Run north-west to exit the cave.
Go over the stepping stones and run directly north.
Squeeze through the hole.

sub.t: If you don't have the shortcut unlocked, you'll have to go all the way around towards Lumbridge Castle's Cellar.
If at any point Zanik stops following you, she can be found back at Juna.

steps.t: Right click Follow Kazgar. [Chat: 1 Dorgeshuun Mines]
Enter Dorgesh-Kaan and talk to Captain Undak north of the market (between the fountains). [Chat: 4 What can I do? › 4 Goodbye.]
Climb the northern stairs for a cutscene (close the Bandos's Ultimatum screen that pops up). [Chat: Any]
Climb back up the stairs, talk to the Goblin scribe. [Chat: 1 What do you want me to do? › 2 I'll help you. › 1 I'll go now.]
Climb down the stairs and run south-east through a corridor (near the quest start point).
Talk to Tegdak in the north-east room of the floor 1. [Chat: 2 The scribe sent me to get a box of artefacts.]
Return to the Goblin scribe upstairs. [Chat: 1 Here it is. › 1 I'll go now.]
Exit the city through the bone door north-east, downstairs.
Talk to Mistag. [Chat: 1 Could you bury this time capsule?]
Return to the city and talk to Oldak north of the bank. [Chat: 1 What are you arguing about? › Any › 1 What do you want me to do? › 1 I'll go now.]

sub.t: [Chat: 2 No - talk about quest or other things.] if invention has been unlocked.

steps.t: Return to the agility course (south end of Dorgesh-Kaan) - do not climb down the ladder.
Run east to the power station and climb down the stairs.
Talk to Turgall, make sure you have at least 2 free inventory spots . [Chat: 2 Oldak needs a pair of energy projectors and a focusing chamber.]
Talk to Oldak, now south-east of the market. [Chat: 1 I have the parts here.]
Talk to Zanik. [Chat: 1 Oldak has modified your crossbow. › 1 Oldak said it was certain to work. › 3 I'll talk to you later.]
Talk to Mernik in the children's nursery north-east upstairs. [Chat: 1 What can I do? › 1 I'll talk to him.]
Talk to Ambassador Alvijar in the house north-west of the nursery. [Chat: 2 I want to talk about the children. › 1 You coward!]
Return to Mernik. [Chat: 1 I talked to him... He said no. › 1 Nothing. Everything is fine.]
Prepare to fight enemies weak to magic.
Talk to Zanik, south-east of the market. [Chat: 2 I'm ready now.]
Defeat the Bandos avatar. [Chat: 4 We'll see about that. Zanik - now!]
p: Zanik leads the invasion of goblins.
Bandos takes over the goblin High Priest.
The battle with the Bandos avatar.

steps.t: Pick up all 4 parts of the crossbow while killing statues.
Use the crossbow pieces on each other. [Chat: 5 Enough talk.]
Kill the avatar again. [Chat: 4 [Use Zanik's crossbow's special attack.]]
Take the avatar's pendant.
Talk to Zanik. [Chat: 4 [Sit down next to Zanik.] › 4 [Say nothing.] › 3 About time you woke up! › 2 We won. Oldak's crossbow worked. › 3 The mark on your forehead is gone. › 3 Here it is.]
Exit through the portal.
Click the screen to exit cutscene.
Quest complete!

p: In the council room with Zanik
Zanik stuck on a rock wall.
Confronting the Big High War God
